CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS5(`brand`, `model`, `plate`, `note`, tokenize=`unicode61`, content=`cars`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_cars_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `cars` BEGIN DELETE FROM `cars_fts` WHERE `rowid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_cars_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `cars` BEGIN DELETE FROM `cars_fts` WHERE `rowid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_cars_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `cars` BEGIN INSERT INTO `cars_fts`(`rowid`, `brand`, `model`, `plate`, `note`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`brand`, NEW.`model`, NEW.`plate`, NEW.`note`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_cars_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `cars` BEGIN INSERT INTO `cars_fts`(`rowid`, `brand`, `model`, `plate`, `note`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`brand`, NEW.`model`, NEW.`plate`, NEW.`note`); END
